"""The held-out bowl, measured once, after overlap-policy/v1 was fixed.

Run from the worktree root: uv run python /tmp/held_out_bowl.py
Reads the 51 bowl photographs through the .exulanica symlink and the two 51-camera pose
receipts in the retained store. Runs no reconstruction and touches no database.
"""

import glob
import hashlib
import json
import time
from pathlib import Path

import exulanica
from exulanica.capture import Photograph, assess_capture_set, outcome_from_pose_receipt
from exulanica.capture.verdict import POLICY_V1

assert "recovery-readiness" in exulanica.__file__
ROOT = Path.cwd()
PHOTOS = ROOT / ".exulanica/reference-baseline/inputs/chili-salmon-bowl/images"
names = sorted(path.name for path in PHOTOS.iterdir() if path.suffix.lower() == ".jpg")
digests = {hashlib.sha256((PHOTOS / name).read_bytes()).hexdigest(): name for name in names}
print("bowl photographs", len(names))
# The known outcome, read from the receipts rather than assumed: the exact-set scenes' pose
# receipts in the retained store, matched to these photographs by SHA-256.
for prefix in ("292d697b", "d3563ac2", "2976a64d"):
    path = Path(glob.glob(str(ROOT / f".exulanica/reference-baseline/runtime/blobs/sha-256/*/*/{prefix}*"))[0])
    data = path.read_bytes()
    assert hashlib.sha256(data).hexdigest() == path.name
    receipt = json.loads(data)
    frames = receipt["manifest"]["frames"]
    matched = sum(1 for frame in frames if frame["sha256"] in digests)
    outcome = outcome_from_pose_receipt(receipt)
    print(f"receipt {path.name[:12]}: {len(frames)} frames, {matched} are bowl photographs, outcome {outcome.state}, registered {outcome.registered_count} of {outcome.member_count}, accepted {outcome.accepted}, reasons {receipt['quality']['reasons']}")
started = time.perf_counter()
verdict = assess_capture_set([Photograph.from_path(name, PHOTOS / name) for name in names], POLICY_V1)
print(f"verdict in {time.perf_counter() - started:.2f} s: ceiling {verdict.predicted_ceiling}, worth {verdict.worth_attempting}, fault {verdict.fault}, advisories {list(verdict.advisories)}")
graph = verdict.graph
print(f"measured {graph.measured_count} of {graph.photograph_count}, edges {len(graph.edges)} of {len(graph.measurement.pair_scores)} pairs, largest {graph.largest_component}, groups {graph.groups}, isolated {graph.isolated}, structure {graph.structure}")
print("unavailable", [(p.ref, p.reason) for p in graph.measurement.photographs if p.state != "measured"])
print("working sizes", sorted({(p.width, p.height) for p in graph.measurement.photographs}))
print("digest", verdict.sha256().hex())
flips = []
previous = None
import dataclasses
from exulanica.capture.verdict import verdict_for_measurement
for t in range(1, 61):
    ceiling = verdict_for_measurement(graph.measurement, dataclasses.replace(POLICY_V1, edge_min_score=t)).predicted_ceiling
    if ceiling != previous:
        flips.append(f"t>={t}: {ceiling}")
        previous = ceiling
print("verdict by threshold:", "; ".join(flips))
for line in verdict.instructions():
    print("says:", line.headline, line.detail, line.action or "")
